label: Distributed ACID Transaction (Java SDK)
type: a multi-document, multi-operation unit of work executed via a retryable lambda passed to Cluster.transactions().run() - automatically committed on success or rolled back and retried on failure
note: Structurally distinct from sdk:kv-operations and sdk:sqlpp-queries-with-sdk (both single-call, single-outcome operations, still only at the extraction layer themselves - see round-4 note in reconciliation.md): this is a whole block of application logic that may re-execute. sdk:single-query-transaction (extraction-layer only, not yet promoted) is a lighter-weight, structurally restricted variant of this concept, not simply an instance of it.
